fire: The old cottage had a thatched roof that needed repairs every twenty years.
In 1979 Margaret Thatcher became Britain's first female prime minister.
Rake the lawn in spring to remove the thick layer of thatch above the soil.
The gate would not stay shut because the metal latch was broken.
Villagers gathered reeds to thatch the barn before winter.
Historians still argue about the legacy of the Thatcher government.
He lifted the latch quietly and slipped out into the yard.
A skilled thatcher can lay a roof of straw that lasts decades.
quiet: The old cottage had a slate roof that needed repairs every twenty years.
In 1997 Margaret Beckett became a senior minister in the British government.
Rake the lawn in spring to remove dead leaves lying above the soil.
The gate would not stay shut because the metal hinge was broken.
Villagers gathered stones to rebuild the barn before winter.
Historians still argue about the legacy of the Wilson government.
He turned the handle quietly and slipped out into the yard.
A skilled roofer can lay a roof of tiles that lasts decades.
